owasp_api_cross_reference: API8:2023 Security Misconfiguration / cryptographic failures — weak password hashing (MD5), plaintext PII at rest, session cookies without Secure
summary: Password hashing uses unsalted MD5, order customer_phone (and other shipping PII) is stored plaintext without encryption at rest, and the web session cookie is issued without the Secure flag (https_only=False).

evidence.description: Detection suite asserting Argon2/bcrypt password digests, encrypted PII at rest, and Secure (+ HttpOnly) session cookies; fails on vulnerable red-phase MD5 hashing, plaintext phone storage, and https_only=False.
